analyst_view.overall: Early view: Porto lead the league unbeaten with 33 points from 11 games under Francesco Farioli, while Estrela have lost five league games in a row, the last a close 3-2 defeat to Benfica. Porto play at Liverpool in the Champions League on Wednesday 9 December, four days earlier, so some rotation is likely. Porto were also without wide players Oskar and William at Guimarães on 8 November.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Porto under Farioli control games rather than run up scores, they had to grind out a 2-1 at Guimarães, and a trip to Liverpool four days before points to a rotated side. Estrela gave Benfica a hard game, so I lean a little lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, mostly Porto's. Porto should pin Estrela back, but they were short of wide players in early November, which can reduce crosses and corners. Those two point in opposite directions, so I keep it level.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards. Estrela will spend long spells defending, which brings fouls, but the referee is not known yet. I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.1 shots. Porto will have most of the ball, but rotation after Liverpool could make them less sharp. I see no clear reason to move off the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. Porto at home should test the goalkeeper often, but against Guimarães they also had goals ruled out and missed chances. I keep it level for now.
